title: •Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk
caption: •Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Deploys -2 to Kashyyyk. While stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!, Wookiees are power and forfeit +1. While hit, Chewie’s power is doubled. If you have 8 or more cards in hand, add one destiny to total power in any battle involving your Wookiee.
lore: Wookiee scout. Volunteered for Han’s Endor strike team. Keeps his distance, but doesn’t look like he’s keeping his distance. Always thinks with his stomach.

notes: Group (sheet sub-heading): Battle Of Kashyyyk. Unique. Stats POWER 7 (printed 6) / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4 (printed third box empty); deploy 6 / forfeit 7 as printed. Leading yellow LS pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub expands it). Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior (blue box, rifle), then a black EPISODE I disc above the set sphere → 'episode1' (not on the printed Endor card). Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). Curly apostrophe Chewie’s. Slip text matches the stub. Lore: wiki wording matches the scan; curly apostrophes as printed. 'scout' is NOT visibly bold on the 350 px Endor scan (the PC's VB5 re-typeset bolds it) — left plain (renderer bolds keywords itself). Only a 350 px base scan; copyright Endor line by set (year 1999 legible). Modern: V27-L-chewbaccaofkashyyyk.gif (745, a LATER PC version — Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V) VS27 — same art, used for art quality) and VB5-L-chewbaccaofkashyyyk-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5, a different later text).
